info.name: Field Trip Spot Logger API
info.description: Run the folders in order (1 to 4). Fill seedPassword in the Current value column only. Wait about a minute between full runs: login is rate limited to 5 attempts per minute.

item.name: Register (tries to sneak in role ADMIN)

exec: pm.test('Role is EXPLORER even though ADMIN was sent', () => pm.expect(json.role).to.eql('EXPLORER'));
pm.test('Has data array and pagination meta', () => {
pm.test('Finds at least one spot', () => pm.expect(json.data).to.not.be.empty);
pm.test('Every spot is in the requested category', () => {
pm.test('Includes category, rating summary and creator', () => {
pm.test('Visitors expose only id and name', () => {
pm.test('Profile has identity fields and counts', () => {
pm.test('Creator comes from the token, not the body', () => pm.expect(json.createdById).to.eql(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('userId'))));
pm.test('Name was updated', () => pm.expect(json.name).to.eql('Postman Test Spot (renamed)'));
pm.test('Message tells the user to update instead', () => pm.expect(json.message).to.include('already'));
pm.test('Generic error message', () => pm.expect(json.message).to.eql('Invalid email or password'));

item.name: Visit on a spot that does not exist (expect 404)

exec: pm.test('Message says it already exists', () => pm.expect(json.message).to.include('already exists'));

item.name: Delete a category that still has spots (expect 409)

exec: pm.test('Message explains spots still use it', () => pm.expect(json.message).to.include('still use'));
